Support the day-to-day implementation of activities by Field Enterprise Coaches to achieve targeted outcomes and maximize the impact of interventions for micro-, nano-, and migrant family enterprises. Technical Support Provide practical technical support to migrant family enterprises, assisting them in adopting low-literacy business tools, record-keeping practices, and basic digital solutions such as MFS and WhatsApp to improve business performance. Coordinate with external technical specialists and internal teams to address specific operational, packaging, branding, or strategic challenges faced by client enterprises. Capacity Building Design and deliver the five-day induction and certification programme for female Field Enterprise Coaches, strengthening the technical delivery capabilities of the field team. Support the delivery of the complete enterprise coaching journey, including implementation of Bangla handbook modules through multiple channels (courtyard sessions, business visits, and calls), completion of Kobo data forms (profiling and daily logs), submission of field reports, and facilitation of peer-learning opportunities to promote continuous professional development among Field Enterprise Coaches. Technical Representation & Knowledge Management Represent Truvalu`s BDS technical methodology in client review meetings, donor interactions, and multi-stakeholder enterprise forums.
